verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is a live-media transport relay and CDN server that connects publishers to subscribers. Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is outside this product type's axis, much like source control for a VPN. Nothing in the evidence shows a scheduling capability. The SageOx 'jobs' are always-on subscribers fanning out from a broadcast, not scheduled recurring tasks, so they do not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
